points: \item Fine-tuned Vision-Language Alignment (VLA) models for advanced robotic perception tasks, significantly improving object recognition and scene interpretation accuracy.
\item Curated and preprocessed large-scale multi-modal datasets from simulation and real-world sources, ensuring high-quality training data for robust AI models.
\item Collaborated with simulation engineers to validate model performance in Isaac Sim and Omniverse, bridging the gap between synthetic environments and real-world deployment.
\item Optimized training pipelines and model integration workflows on AWS SageMaker, enhancing the scalability and efficiency of robotic AI systems.
\item Supported the real-world deployment of VLA models on robotic platforms, conducting rigorous testing to ensure safety and reliability in dynamic environments.
\item Analyzed model outputs to provide actionable insights for iterative improvements, driving the continuous advancement of perception capabilities.
